nom: Beauty of Joseon Apricot Blossom Peeling Gel Soft Exfoliating Face and Body Scrub Dead Skin Cells Remover for All Skin T

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive or reactive skin are divided: several, including one with 'super picky' skin that usually reacts badly to products, report it is gentler than other exfoliants and doesn't make them break out, but multiple others report an allergic-type rash or reaction, including one with insanely dry, sensitive skin who had a mild reaction limited to redness.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one with a persistent dry patch on her forehead, report the strongest, most consistent results: immediately softer, smoother skin, though a couple note the product itself isn't moisturizing and needs a follow-up moisturizer.
segments.combination: The one reviewer with combination, acne-prone skin reports the opposite of most others: it left her skin dry and caused more breakouts.

concerns.blemishes: Reports diverge sharply here: several reviewers, including one who says almost every other cleanser or exfoliant has made her break out worse, report this one does not cause breakouts and even helped clear acne that had persisted for years; against this, a few reviewers, including one with combination, acne-prone skin, say it caused new breakouts within the first week.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers report no irritation at all, but a few describe a rash or allergic-type reaction after first use, including one with professional skincare experience; one reviewer with sensitive skin had a milder version of this, limited to redness without burning.
concerns.dehydration: A few reviewers say it left their skin feeling dry or irritated, especially alongside reported breakouts; several reviewers with dry skin instead report it leaves skin soft and smooth, though a couple note the product itself has no moisturizing effect and should be followed with a separate moisturizer.
concerns.spots: Two reviewers report it removed stubborn dark, dead-skin buildup, in one case long-standing dark rings around the neck and in another dark, dulled skin on a child, that other scrubbing methods had not been able to shift.

aspects.libelle: Distinctive pilling texture rolls dead skin into little balls
Reviewers disagree on whether to apply to dry or damp skin
Affordable price for the amount of product
A few describe the balled-up texture as sticky or fiddly to spread
Some past concern about counterfeit or non-official Amazon listings

extraits.texte: I’m a Master Esthetician and skincare junkie, no rookie to aggressive product or treatments. I know what I’m doing, and I’ve NEVER had this happen after using a product once. I used this enzyme last night for the first time and followed it with my usual routine, no other new products. I woke up with this rash on both cheeks and forehead. I know this product is the culprit because I only used it on my face, whereas all my other products I carry down my neck and chest. My neck and chest are clear. I reviewed the ingredients before purchasing, I know I’m not allergic to any of them. A gommage(enzyme exfoliant) is typically less aggressive than a physical face scrub, so maybe I got a bad batch? No other harsh products were used in the same routine. My professional opinion? Don’t buy this, if it’s irritating the skin of someone who works in the industry then theres something amiss. I hope I can return but obviously I did open and use it.

Hello everyone! I typically never write reviews but this deserves it. I’ve been struggling with acne for 16 years now. Nothing worked. My skin always looked dull, felt rough and was always breaking out. I’ve tried every different type of skin care adjusting my routine according to my skin and honestly, this exfoliant is staying in my routine FOREVER. No matter what other products I use with this exfoliant, my skin always comes out soft/smooth and my acne cleared up!!! I’ve never seen my skin so glowy, soft and acne free. Thank you Beauty of Joseon!

extraits.titre: HOLY GRAIL FOR DRY SKIN GIRLIES
extraits.texte: Hands-down, the best exfoliating wash I've ever used. I buy them 3 at a time now. Can't live without it. I have INCREDIBLY dry skin, especially a large patch on my forehead. This is the only exfoliation that gives me immediate results, and leaves my skin soft and smooth.

I thought “peeling mask” meant that it would dry and you would peel it off; but this is actually more of a scrub-and-wash situation. Kinda gross: I have INSANELY dry, sensitive skin, and you can always see the cracks through makeup. Tried this out and immediately little white balls of dead skin started to build up. I don’t think this product has any moisturizing aspects, but my skin is much softer and has a nice glow. I did have a very slight allergic reaction to this because of sensitivity, but no burning or uncomfortable feeling (just redness). 10/10!

This is by far my favorite skin care item I’ve ever had! Does exactly what it says it will, and isn’t too harsh on sensitive skin either. Almost every facial wash/cleanser/exfoliant I’ve ever tried has made me break out worse except this one. Will definitely be buying again!

This stuff is amazing! I’ve had dark rings around my neck for forever that I’m super self conscious about. I’ve tried scrubbing, all sorts of brushes, hydrogen peroxide, etc. and nothing has worked. I just rubbed this in and it took it completely off! I put a glob of fresh scrub for comparison. So satisfying.
